name: Break the Ice
body:
Your humor can make friends.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Perform [comedy]) (feat) or natural comedian racial characteristic

Benefit(s): You can change the initial attitudes (see Diplomacy) of non-player characters as a full-round action. Targets must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Perform (comedy) skill check modifier) or their attitude improves by one step. This is a charm, enchantment, and language-dependent effect. You cannot make a creature helpful this way, the best possible attitude you can achieve is friendly. You cannot use Perform (comedy) to influence a given creature’s attitude more than once in a 24 hour period.
